  "title": "Backend Engineer",
  "description": "Kuda is a full service, app-based digital bank. Our mission is to be the go-to bank not just for those living on the African continent, but also for the African diaspora wherever they might live, anywhere in the world. Kuda is free of ridiculous banking charges and great at helping customers budget, spend smartly and save more. We raised the largest seed round ever seen in Africa, and completed a Series A funding round in February 2021, led by some of the world&#39;s smartest venture capital investors. With offices in London (our HQ), Lagos and Cape Town, and further offices opening across Africa during 2021, Kuda is fast becoming recognised as the leading &#39;Neobank&#39; for Africans.

To help us grow into the company that can bring meaningful change to the way people across Africa get access to great financial products and services in order to take control of their personal finances, we are actively looking for bright, talented, driven people who are excited by our mission. If this sounds like a great way to spend your valuable time, then please get in touch with us.

We are&nbsp;&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Backend Engineer

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Job Schedule: Full time (Hybrid)

Role&nbsp;


	We are looking for a result-driven and analytical software engineer (backend) who will troubleshoot and improve existing backend applications and processes.
	S/he will use his or her understanding of programming tools and languages to analyze current codes, formulate more efficient processes, solve problems and create a more seamless experience for users.


Responsibilities


	Main focus on coding and debugging
	Build high-quality reusable code that can be used in the future
	Develop functional and sustainable web applications with clean codes
	Troubleshoot and debug applications
	Conduct tests and optimise performance
	Work together with engineers building client-facing applications to integrate UI elements with server-side logic
	Implement modern technologies to improve legacy applications
	Collect, analyse and address technical and design requirements
	Help to create reusable code and libraries for future use
	Train and support internal teams
	Interact with developers, designers and system administrators to identify new features
	Stay informed about emerging technologies


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or Higher in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent
	5+ years of industry experience
	Strong computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures background
	Model of software engineering best practices, including agile development, unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting
	Solid experience with C#, .Net, .Net Core
	Strong computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures background
	A deep understanding of Source Code Management
	Possess an in-depth understanding of Cloud Technologies (Azure, AWS)
	A great understanding of databases and SQL
	An in-depth understanding of REST APIs, SOAP &amp; RPC
	Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
	Experience in technical writing and API documentation
	Familiar with project management tools (e.g Trello, Jira, etc)


Personal Attributes:


	Willing to embrace and enrich Kuda culture of empathy, teamwork and passion
	Have a strong desire for learning and growth
	Passionate about improving developer productivity
	Strive for speed and quality
	Desire to automate


What We Offer


	A great and upbeat work environment populated by a multinational team
	Pension
	&nbsp;Career development &amp; growth
	Competitive annual leave plus bank holidays
	Competitive paid time off (Parental, Moving day, Birthday, Study leave etc)
	Group life insurance
	Medical insurance
	Well-fare package (Wedding, Compassionate and etc)
	Perkbox
	Goalr - employee wellness app
	Award winning L&amp;D training
	We are advocates of work-life balance, working in a hybrid in office schedule.

Backend Engineer Job at Kuda Bank




        
    

        
        Kuda is a full service, app-based digital bank. Our mission is to be the go-to bank not just for those living on the African continent, but also for the African diaspora wherever they might live, anywhere in the world. Kuda is free of ridiculous banking charges and great at helping customers budget, spend smartly and save more. We raised the largest seed round ever seen in Africa, and completed a Series A funding round in February 2021, led by some of the world's smartest venture capital investors. With offices in London (our HQ), Lagos and Cape Town, and further offices opening across Africa during 2021, Kuda is fast becoming recognised as the leading 'Neobank' for Africans.
     

            
    



To help us grow into the company that can bring meaningful change to the way people across Africa get access to great financial products and services in order to take control of their personal finances, we are actively looking for bright, talented, driven people who are excited by our mission. If this sounds like a great way to spend your valuable time, then please get in touch with us.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Backend Engineer

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Job Schedule: Full time (Hybrid)

Role 


	We are looking for a result-driven and analytical software engineer (backend) who will troubleshoot and improve existing backend applications and processes.
	S/he will use his or her understanding of programming tools and languages to analyze current codes, formulate more efficient processes, solve problems and create a more seamless experience for users.


Responsibilities


	Main focus on coding and debugging
	Build high-quality reusable code that can be used in the future
	Develop functional and sustainable web applications with clean codes
	Troubleshoot and debug applications
	Conduct tests and optimise performance
	Work together with engineers building client-facing applications to integrate UI elements with server-side logic
	Implement modern technologies to improve legacy applications
	Collect, analyse and address technical and design requirements
	Help to create reusable code and libraries for future use
	Train and support internal teams
	Interact with developers, designers and system administrators to identify new features
	Stay informed about emerging technologies


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or Higher in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent
	5+ years of industry experience
	Strong computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures background
	Model of software engineering best practices, including agile development, unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting
	Solid experience with C#, .Net, .Net Core
	Strong computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures background
	A deep understanding of Source Code Management
	Possess an in-depth understanding of Cloud Technologies (Azure, AWS)
	A great understanding of databases and SQL
	An in-depth understanding of REST APIs, SOAP & RPC
	Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
	Experience in technical writing and API documentation
	Familiar with project management tools (e.g Trello, Jira, etc)


Personal Attributes:


	Willing to embrace and enrich Kuda culture of empathy, teamwork and passion
	Have a strong desire for learning and growth
	Passionate about improving developer productivity
	Strive for speed and quality
	Desire to automate


What We Offer


	A great and upbeat work environment populated by a multinational team
	Pension
	 Career development & growth
	Competitive annual leave plus bank holidays
	Competitive paid time off (Parental, Moving day, Birthday, Study leave etc)
	Group life insurance
	Medical insurance
	Well-fare package (Wedding, Compassionate and etc)
	Perkbox
	Goalr - employee wellness app
	Award winning L&D training
	We are advocates of work-life balance, working in a hybrid in office schedule.

Sales Representative Job at Excel and Grace Consulting




        
    

        
        Excel and Grace Consulting is a fast-paced business consulting organization with a track record of delivering exceptional business solutions to small and medium-scale enterprises in Nigeria, Ghana, Germany, Switzerland, Canada, etc. We are certified management consultants with the International Council of Management Consulting Institutes (CMC-Global) with over 18 years of experience. Our team of experts and consultants have authored over 20 books on business management, business structure, business operations, human resources, organizational structure, employee development, money management, and so on.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Representative
     

            
    



Job Location: GRA Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Sales Representative is responsible for generating leads, building client relationships, and achieving sales targets.
	This role involves identifying customer needs, presenting suitable products or services, and closing sales to help grow the business.
	An ideal candidate is goal-oriented, persuasive, and has excellent interpersonal skills.


Key Responsibilities


	Receive, process, and confirm customer orders via phone, whatsapp, email, website, and in-person visits.
	Conduct field visits to pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, and distributors to generate new orders.
	Promote company products and communicate ongoing promotions to customers.
	Achieve assigned sales targets and expand customer base.
	Follow up on pending payments and outstanding invoices.
	Maintain accurate records of orders, customer interactions, and sales activities.
	Provide market feedback on competitor pricing and customer demand trends.
	Coordinate with warehouse/logistics to ensure timely order fulfillment.


Qualifications


	Candidates should possess a Degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not always required with 3 - 5 years of experience
	Proven work experience as a Sales Representative or similar role.
	Highly motivated and target-driven with a proven track record in sales.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to create and deliver presentations tailored to the audience needs.


Salary
N250,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected], [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Brandex Contractors Limited is a Nigerian construction and infrastructure development company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Ikeja, Lagos. The company is involved in the planning, execution, commissioning, and maintenance of various construction projects and has a team of professionals with experience in helping clients with real estate challenges.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Project Management Officer

Job Location: Costain, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Project Management Officer to support the planning, coordination, monitoring, and successful execution of construction projects.
	The ideal candidate will work closely with project managers, site teams, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved quality and safety standards.
	The Project Management Officer will be responsible for maintaining effective project documentation, tracking project progress, monitoring timelines and deliverables, coordinating project activities, and providing timely reports to support informed management decisions


Key Responsibilities


	Support the planning, coordination, and monitoring of construction projects from initiation through completion.
	Develop and maintain project schedules, work plans, trackers, and project documentation to ensure timely execution of project activities.
	Monitor project progress against approved timelines, milestones, budgets, and deliverables, and promptly highlight delays, risks, and potential issues.
	Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
	Prepare and maintain accurate project reports, status updates, meeting minutes, action trackers, and other relevant project documentation.
	Track project costs and expenditure in collaboration with the Finance and Project teams, ensuring activities remain within approved budgets.
	Assist in monitoring the procurement and delivery of materials, equipment, and other resources required for project execution.
	Maintain an up-to-date project risk, issue, and change log, escalating critical matters to the Project Manager when necessary.
	Support project teams in identifying operational challenges and developing practical solutions to minimize delays and cost overruns.
	Ensure project documentation, approvals, contracts, drawings, reports, and other records are properly maintained and easily accessible.
	Monitor compliance with approved project procedures, company policies, health and safety requirements, and relevant construction standards.
	Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and ensure alignment on project objectives and deliverables.
	Assist in preparing project presentations and management reports, providing insights on project performance, progress, risks, and outstanding actions.
	Support project close-out activities, including documentation, lessons learned, handover processes, and post-project reviews.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Business Administration, or a related field.
	3–5 years of relevant experience in project coordination, project management, or project administration, preferably within the construction, or real estate industry.
	Professional certification in Project Management, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or CAPM, will be an added advantage.
	Good knowledge of project management principles, construction processes, project scheduling, and documentation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is an added advantage.
	Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, cost tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
	Excellent analytical, organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Key Competencies:
	Strong project coordination and organizational skills
	Excellent time management and ability to prioritize multiple tasks
	Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation
	Ability to monitor project timelines, budgets, and deliverables effectively
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
	Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
	Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight project deadlines
	Proactive approach with strong follow-up and accountability
	Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams
	High level of integrity, professionalism, and commitment to company values.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using “Application for Project Management Officer” as the subject of the mail.

 

2.) Civil Engineer

Job Location: Costain, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are seeking a reliable and proactive Civil Engineer to oversee and support civil engineering and construction activities across project sites. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring that construction works are executed according to approved designs, specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project timelines.
	The ideal candidate will work closely with project managers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of construction projects..


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, coordinate, and supervise civil engineering and construction activities on project sites.
	Interpret and review architectural, structural, and engineering drawings, specifications, and project documents.
	Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, and project requirements.
	Conduct site inspections and identify potential technical issues, defects, or deviations from approved plans.
	Prepare and review technical reports, site reports, progress reports, and relevant project documentation.
	Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to ensure smooth project execution.
	Monitor the use of construction materials and ensure that materials delivered to site meet the required quality and quantity specifications.
	Assist in estimating quantities, preparing bills of quantities, and reviewing project costs where required.
	Ensure that construction activities are completed within approved project timelines and budgets.
	Identify construction risks and recommend practical and cost-effective solutions to technical and site-related challenges.
	Ensure compliance with relevant building codes, engineering standards, health and safety regulations, and company policies.
	Monitor the quality of workmanship and ensure corrective actions are implemented where necessary.
	Maintain accurate records of site activities, measurements, materials, inspections, and project progress.
	Attend project meetings and provide technical input on construction progress, challenges, and required actions.
	Liaise with clients, consultants, government authorities, and other stakeholders as required.
	Support the Project Manager in ensuring successful project delivery from commencement to completion.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline
	3–5 years of experience in Civil Engineering, preferably in the construction or engineering industry.
	Experience working on building, structural, road, infrastructure, or other construction projects is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, site supervision, and quality control procedures.
	Ability to read and interpret engineering, structural, and architectural drawings.
	Knowledge of relevant Nigerian building regulations, engineering standards, and health and safety requirements.
	Strong proficiency in MS Excel and AutoCAD.
	Excellent planning, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
	Professional membership with COREN or relevant engineering certification will be an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strong organizational and coordination skills
	Strong technical and engineering knowledge
	Attention to detail and accountability
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Ability to analyse and solve technical and construction-related problems
	Effective communication and teamwork
	Integrity and commitment to company values
	Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using “Application for Civil Engineer Position” as the subject of the mail.

 

3.) Mechanical Engineer

Job Location: Costain, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a reliable and proactive Mechanical Engineer to support the planning, design, installation, supervision and maintenance of mechanical systems and equipment across our construction sites.
	The ideal candidate will have practical site experience, strong technical knowledge and the ability to work effectively in a team and with stakeholders to ensure that all mechanical work are delivered in line with approved specifications, quality standards and project timelines.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, coordinate, and oversee mechanical engineering works across construction sites and projects.
	Review Drawings, designs, specifications and other technical documents to ensure compliance with project requirements.
	Supervise the installation, testing, and maintenance of mechanical systems, and equipment.
	Monitor contractors to ensure mechanical works are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards and project schedules.
	Conduct regular inspection of mechanical installations and identify defects, technical issues and areas requiring corrective action.
	Prepare and review technical reports, progress reports, inspection records, material schedules, and other relevant project documentation.
	Ensure that mechanical materials, equipment, and components delivered to site meet approved specifications and required quality standards.
	Assist in the preparation of project estimates, material requirements, technical specifications, and procurement documentation.
	Monitor the performance, maintenance, and safe operation of mechanical equipment used on construction sites.
	Ensure compliance with relevant engineering standards, health and safety regulations, environmental requirements, and company policies.
	Identify potential project risks and technical challenges and recommend practical and cost-effective solutions.
	Participate in project meetings, site inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
	Support the timely completion of projects by monitoring mechanical works against agreed project schedules and deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline
	3–5 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, preferably in the construction or engineering industry.
	Knowledge of mechanical systems, equipment, installation practices, testing, and commissioning.
	Ability to interpret and review engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
	Strong proficiency in MS Excel and AutoCAD.
	Excellent planning, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
	Professional membership with COREN or relevant engineering certification will be an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strong organizational and coordination skills
	Attention to detail and accountability
	Excellent project coordination and site supervision skills
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Effective communication and teamwork
	Integrity and commitment to company values.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using “Application for Mechanical Engineer” as the subject of the mail

Utility Manager Job at the International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA)




        
    

        
        The International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA) is a not-for-profit institution that generates agricultural innovations to meet Africa’s most pressing challenges of hunger, malnutrition, poverty, and natural resource degradation. Working with various partners across sub-Saharan Africa, we improve livelihoods, enhance food and nutrition security, increase employment, and preserve natural resource integrity. IITA is a member of CGIAR, a global agriculture research partnership for a food secure future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Utility Manager
     

            
    



Job ID: NRS2026-031
Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Contract: 3-years renewable contract                     

Duties


	Manage daily operations of utility systems (diesel generators, solar panels, electrical distribution, water treatment and supply, waste water management, etc.).
	Plan and coordinate preventive maintenance and repair of utility equipment and infrastructure with utility technicians and external service providers.
	Monitor and analyze utility consumption data (electricity, water, fuel) to identify trends and implement conservation measures.
	Develop and manage budgets for utility operations and coordinate procurement of fuel, chemicals, and spare parts.
	Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations related to utility operations (e.g., emission standards, water quality standards).
	Prepare and maintain documentation for utility assets, maintenance records, and regulatory permits.
	Respond to utility emergencies (power outages, equipment failures) and coordinate rapid resolution to minimize downtime.
	Collaborate with capital projects to plan integration of new utility infrastructure and upgrades (e.g., expanding power generation capacity).
	Liaise with external utility providers and contractors for technical services and negotiate service agreements when required.
	Identify opportunities for renewable energy and sustainable practices in utility management to support FMS environmental goals.
	Any other responsibilities as may be assigned by the supervisor


Requirements
Qualification:


	Higher National Diploma (HND) or Bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
	Possession of NATE or COREN certification is required.
	Minimum of fifteen (15) years of relevant experience in the management and maintenance of electrical distribution systems, household appliances, power generation equipment and machinery, water production facilities, and general utility infrastructure systems.


Competencies:
The ideal candidate must have:


	Technical expertise in electrical distribution and installation systems, water treatment and production.
	Strong analytical skills for tracking performance.
	Organizational ability to manage multiple systems.
	Leadership, supervisory and communication skills for managing staff and stakeholders; knowledge of safety standards for utility facilities.


Benefits
We offer highly competitive salary with equally attractive benefits and excellent working conditions in a pleasant campus environment.

Note: Applicants should complete the online application attaching detailed cover letter and curriculum vitae saved with their names in Microsoft word format to IITA website.

Human Resource Officer (Entry Level)  Job at Delans Group




        
    

        
        Delans Group aim is to provide practical and bespoke solutions to support our clients in bridging the gap between Strategy Development, Talent Acquisition, Strategy Execution, Organizational Performance, Human Capacity Development and Outsourcing services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resource Officer (Entry Level) 

Job Locations: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Requiremets
     

            
    




	Qualified OND, HND, and B.Sc graduates for entry-level opportunities in Administration, Business/Finance, Human Resources, and Public Health.
